one_line: Bajaj Finance allotted 114,146,341 equity shares via QIP at ₹1,025 per share, raising ₹117,000 million.
why: Capital raise dilutes equity and significantly expands the balance sheet for future growth.

promise_links.note: Fresh capital raised of approximately INR 117,000 million supports medium-term growth and AUM expansion towards the FY30 target.
